fusions.name: Closing Grip
fusions.desc: Sends a grasping current that deals 10 damage and leaves the target [Pinned] for 3 seconds. Your afflictions on it spread to enemies within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Squeeze Out
fusions.desc: Consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to this blow, which deals 15 damage. It only strikes a target at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Loosened Grip
fusions.desc: Removes 2 conditions from you. Fighting beside others pays: +11% per ally within 5.5 tiles, capped at 4.

fusions.name: Steady Shoal
fusions.desc: Your critical hit chance rises by 6%. It also hardens your armour by 12% and regenerates 1 health a second, permanently.
